onFileModified.description: Validate all env vars are documented
onFileModified.prompt: I just modified .env.example. Please check: (1) Are all new environment variables documented in CLAUDE.md Section 8.2? (2) Do they have descriptions? (3) Are any variables missing from .env.local example?

onFileModified.description: Check for dependency version conflicts in Java services
onFileModified.prompt: I just modified a pom.xml. Please check for version conflicts: (1) Compare all dependency versions across all pom.xml files in services/. (2) Warn if the same library has different major versions (e.g., spring-boot 3.2 vs 3.1). (3) Suggest updating to aligned versions.

onFileModified.description: Check for dependency version conflicts in Node services
onFileModified.prompt: I just modified a package.json. Please check for version conflicts: (1) Compare all dependency versions across all package.json files. (2) Warn if the same library has different major versions. (3) Suggest yarn resolutions or version alignment.

onFileModified.description: Ensure migration is idempotent and has rollback
onFileModified.prompt: I just created or modified a database migration. Please validate: (1) Does it use IF EXISTS / IF NOT EXISTS for idempotency? (2) Is there a rollback comment at the top (-- ROLLBACK: ...)? (3) Does the filename match NNN_description.sql pattern? (4) Are all column constraints properly defined?

onFileModified.description: Verify Lambda handler matches API contract
onFileModified.prompt: I just modified a Lambda handler. Please verify: (1) Does it handle all routes from the TDD API contract (Section 2.x)? (2) Are error cases mapped to correct HTTP status codes? (3) Is JWT validation present? (4) Does it call the correct service method?

I just modified an auth handler. Please check: (1) Does it match the TDD specification (Section 3.1)? (2) Are all required fields validated? (3) Is JWT generation correct? (4) Are error responses properly formatted?

onFileCreated.description: Scaffold service with repository and tests
onFileCreated.prompt: I just created a new Java service file. Would you like me to auto-scaffold: (1) A corresponding Repository interface in repository/? (2) A unit test stub in src/test/java/?  (3) Basic CRUD method templates? Reply YES or NO.

onFileCreated.description: Scaffold TypeScript handler with types and tests
onFileCreated.prompt: I just created a new TypeScript file. If this is a handler (contains 'handler' in the name), would you like me to scaffold: (1) Type definitions? (2) A unit test file? (3) Error handling stubs? Reply YES or NO.
I just created a new database migration. Let me add a rollback comment block at the top. Please confirm the rollback action is correct: -- ROLLBACK: [describe the reverse operation]
